chapter.verse: Topa aw, kei, hehpihhuai-in cimawh ka hih manin na bil hong ngat in la, hong dawng in.
Mihoih ka hih manin kei hong kem in; nangmah hong muang na nasempa hong hon in.
Nangmah in ka Pasian na hi hi, Topa aw, sun tawntung nang tungah hong kiko ka hih ciangin kei hong hehpih in.
Topa aw, nangma tungah thu hong ngen ka hih manin, na nasempa hong kipaaksak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah hoih-in mawhna na maisak a, nangma tunga hong ngente khempeuh tungah itna kip tampi na nei hi.
Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za in la, thuum-a kikona hong ngai in.
Nangmah in kei hong dawng na hih manin ka haksat hun ciangin nangma tungah kong ngen hi.
Topa aw, pasiante lakah nang tawh a kibang kuamah om lo a, nangma’ sep bang, kuamah in sem thei lo hi.
Topa aw, na bawlsa minam khempeuh hong pai-in na mai-ah hong kun ding a, nangma min hong phat ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in nalamdangte bawlin a lian na hi a, nang bek in Pasian na hi hi.
Topa aw, nang tungah hong thumanin na lampi ka zuih theih nadingin kei hong hilh in; nangma min a zahtakte tawh ka lungsim pumkhat hong hi sak in.
Topa ka Pasian aw, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh nangma tungah ka lungdam a, nangma min ka thangsak ngitnget ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah nong itna kip lian mahmah a, Leinuai thuk sung sihna panin kei nong honkhia khin hi.
Pasian aw, mi kihisakte, kei lang pangin hong tho hi; thuhelhhawt mi pawlkhat in kei, thah hong sawm uh a, amaute in nang hong thudon lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa aw, nangmah in a hehpih thei, a dik Pasian na hi a, heh hak-in, itna kip leh thumanna tawh a kidim na hi hi.
Kei lamah hong kihei in la kei hong hehpih in; na nasempa tungah na thahatna pia in la, na nasem numei’ tapa hong hon in.
Topa nangmah in kei hong huh-in, nong thakhauh sakna hangin, kei hong mudahte in mu-in a zahhuai nadingin keima tungah na maipha hong lak in.
